item.title: Playhead 0.1.0 (build 18)
item.description:
Stability and speed, especially on TVs

  • Detail and series pages no longer search for sources or test torrents as soon as they open. That's what made the TV freeze after a few seconds and then crash. Searching starts only when you press Play or Choose source.
  • Background preloading looks up links only (no data), for a single title: your most recent Continue Watching or Up Next episode. It runs after about 10 s of idle and stops when you start playing. It also actually keeps its result now.
  • Source ranking no longer runs on the thread that draws the screen, so the interface stays responsive while results come in.
  • Searches are lighter: at most 4 requests at once across all indexers, and identical searches run only once and share their results. Leaving a page stops its search.
  • Images are decoded at the size they're shown and fetched from TMDB at smaller sizes. On TV the image cache is capped and cleared when Android runs low on memory.
  • On low-memory and 32-bit Android devices the torrent engine uses fewer peers and threads. The player's in-memory buffer is sized to the device's RAM; the engine still keeps about 45 s on disk.
  • Less redrawing when focus moves, and no entrance animations on TV.
  • TMDB details are kept in memory, so opening the same title again is instant.
